lines.t: For the truth in your embrace
In the fire, in the flow
There's freedom in letting you know
Teach me how to love through the pain
Show me how your grace remains
Let me walk inside your life
I'm fighting love, I'm fighting fate Let me tear, let me give, let me pray
Even the broken are welcome here Mercy falls like rain
Sing hope to the hurtin' old
Your love is a fortress, your call is a song Standing strong together, I know I belong
Abiding love, let it ring Abiding truth, let me sing
Trumping words that bring the dawn This is the promise I live on
My body in love, my body in truth
Trumping words that bring the dawn
This is the promise I live on
